data.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd
data.about: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd is one of the most diversified automobile company in India with presence across 2-wheelers, 3-wheelers, PVs, CVs, tractors & earthmovers.It also has presence across financial services, auto components, hospitality, infrastructure, retail, logistics, steel trading and processing, IT businesses, agri, aerospace, consulting services, defence, energy and industrial equipmentthrough its subsidiaries and group companies.It was incorporated in 1945 by Ghulam Mohammad and two Mahindra Brothers (KC & JC Mahindra) and was later renamed as Mahindra & Mahindra in 1948.[1]

data.what_it_does: Mahindra & Mahindra sells a diverse portfolio of vehicles and equipment across India and globally. Its Automotive segment sells passenger vehicles (including SUVs and EVs), light commercial vehicles, and trucks & buses to both consumer and commercial customers. Its Farm Equipment segment sells tractors, harvesters, and other farm machinery to farmers and agricultural businesses. The company also manufactures aerostructures for global aerospace OEMs.

bull.text: Revenue and PAT have grown at 17.8% and 17.9% CAGR over 3 years, reaching TTM revenue of ₹211,376 Cr and PAT of ₹20,243 Cr.
Operating margin improved to 18.6% from 16.7% three years ago, with ROCE at 15%.
Quarterly momentum shows consistent growth: Jun 2026 quarter revenue ₹58,188 Cr and PAT ₹5,998 Cr, up from Sep 2025's ₹46,106 Cr and ₹3,964 Cr.

bear.text: High leverage with debt-to-equity of 1.47 and poor cash conversion (operating cash flow/PAT of only 0.2 over 3 years).
Profits not converting to cash is explicitly flagged as a key risk.
Many management growth targets (e.g., 15-20% annual growth for 5 years, ₹3 lakh crore book by 2031) remain aspirational and unverified by reported financials.
